SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 25002644
DOCKET NO. L630915 J212617
PLAINTIFF – BANK OF AMERICA, N.A.
DEFENDANTS- EAPT SOLUTIONS, INC., ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday THE 1st DAY OF July 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Township of PISCATAWAY, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 16 C0196 BLOCK 405.01
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
196 BARCLAY COURT PISCATAWAY, NJ 08854
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes: All that tract or parcel of land and premises, situate, lying and being in the Township of
Piscataway, in County of Middlesex, State of New Jersey, more particularly described as follows:
Unit 196 in building 89 situated in Maple Grove at Piscataway, a condominium, together with and undivided .3279 percentage interest, in the common elements of the condominium, hereinafter referred to. The conveyance evidence by this deed is made under the provisions of and is subject to the New Jersey Condominium Act (N.J.S.A. 46:8B-1 ET SEQ.) and the planned Real Estate Development Full Disclosure Act (N.J.S.A 45:22A-21 1 ET SEQ., As amended, and any applicable regulations adopted under either law. The conveyance evidenced by this deed is also made in accordance with the terms, limitations, conditions, convents, restrictions, easements, agreements and other provisions set for in that certain master deed for Maple Grove at Piscataway, a condominium, dated March 11, 1997 and recorded in Middlesex County in Deed
Book 4402 page 005 ET SEQ„ and as same may now or hereafter be lawfully amended and
covenants and restrictions contained in the declaration of Canterbury at Piscataway
Community Association, INC. pursuant to the total upset amount of $275,000.00.
Being known as LOT 16 C0196 IN BLOCK 405.01 ON THE TAX MAP OF THE TOWNSHIP OF
PISCATAWAY.
Commonly known as 196 BARCLAY COURT, PISCATAWAY, NJ 08854.
Tax ID: 3101-16.01.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $455,454.06 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: May 5, 2026
WONG FLEMING PC
821 ALEXANDER ROAD
SUITE 200
PRINCETON, NJ 08543
609-951-9520
